claim.text: Only the open permissions are available without approval. Most permissions and partner programs need LinkedIn's explicit approval.

evidence.quote: Most permissions and partner programs require explicit approval from LinkedIn.

summary: It depends on what you need. Sign in with LinkedIn and Share on LinkedIn are self-serve: add the product to your app and go. Anything beyond that (advertising, sales, talent, learning) needs LinkedIn's approval or a partner program, and the docs state no timeline for any of them.

composio.note: Composio lists a managed OAuth app for LinkedIn, which covers the open permissions. LinkedIn Ads is listed separately as bring-your-own, so for advertising you register and get approved yourself.

scopeTiers.text: Open permissions (Sign in with LinkedIn, Share on LinkedIn) are available to all developers without special approval.

evidence.quote: Open Permissions are the only permissions that are available to all developers without special approval.

scopeTiers.text: Advertising API permissions must be approved.

evidence.quote: Developers seeking to build a marketing related integration using Advertising API permissions must be approved.

scopeTiers.text: Compliance permissions are closed and cannot be requested.

evidence.quote: Access is closed and may not be requested.

steps.text: Create an app in the LinkedIn Developer Portal. Products can then be enabled on it.

evidence.quote: LinkedIn products can be enabled after creating a new application.

steps.text: For the open permissions, add the product yourself on the Products tab of your app page.

evidence.quote: may be added via self-service through the LinkedIn [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/), under the Products tab on your application page.

steps.text: For advertising, apply by adding the Advertising API product to your app.

evidence.quote: You can apply for access through the [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/). To do this, select your app from [My Apps](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps), navigate to the Products tab, and add the Advertising API product.

steps.text: Once accepted into the Development Tier, you can manage up to 5 ad accounts.

evidence.quote: Add up to 5 accounts to manage in the Development Tier.

steps.text: For sales integrations, you must be approved as a Sales Navigator Application Platform (SNAP) partner.

evidence.quote: must be approved as a Sales Navigator Application Platform (SNAP) partner.

steps.text: Talent integrations go through partner programs you can apply to.

evidence.quote: Developers seeking to build talent related integrations through one of the programs listed below can [apply here](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/ats-partners/partner-application).

steps.text: For learning integrations, request access through the LinkedIn Learning API space.

evidence.quote: Developers seeking to build a learning related integration should refer to the [Request API Access](../../learning/getting-started/request-access) page within the LinkedIn Learning API space.

requirements.text: All the marketing permission scopes are 3-legged: they need explicit consent from a LinkedIn member.
